eps.d: Moschops discovers the first flower. Can he save her from the monster?
Flower is ill. Mr. Ichthyosaurus casts a spell to make her better.
What is the strange light in the night sky? Moschops has the answer.
Uncle Tyrannosaurus Rex decides it's time for Ally's fierceness lessons.
Mrs. Kerry returns from holiday to find the desert in a terrible state. Everyone is made to help clear up the mess.
It's time for Ally to stand up to Uncle Rex, but he isn't big enough. Moschops has an idea that can help.
Flower needs water, but when there is no rain Ally and Moschops have the solution.
When there's no food left the dinosaurs decide it's time to leave, until Moschops has an idea.
'Sundays are for sleeping' says Ally, but Moschops has other ideas.
Flower's shadow gives Moschops an idea and the dinosaurs have fun with his latest invention.
Moschops and Ally take flower exploring. What do they find when Ally gets homesick?
Moschops and Ally decide to move house when Mrs. Kerry insists on tidying up their cave.
Mr. Ichthyosaurus is happy that it's raining and cloudy, but Ally and Moschops wonder where the sun has gone.
